recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up studio portrait of a man with styled silver-grey hair against a solid, textured deep blue background, featuring bold, multi-layered sans-serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones and multi-colored shirt contrast against the cool blue backdrop
Large white display text anchors the top left corner
Vertical stripes on the shirt lead the eye upward toward the face
Small-scale tracklist text balances the large artist name
coreInvariants: Solid blue studio background with subtle vignetting
Subject wearing a vertical-striped collared shirt
High-contrast studio lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large white sans-serif name at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white text, moves down to the face, then follows the shirt stripes back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample blue space in the upper third and around the head to accommodate text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow (secondary text) and multi-colored stripes (muted red, green, tan)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark blue; moderate saturation in the shirt stripes.
paletteRestrictions: Limit background to a single tonal family

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the main name
Tall x-height for the display font
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed white sans-serif paired with a smaller, wider yellow sans-serif for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical divider line separating text blocks

preserve: Tight tracking on the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, tall, and tight feel of the main name.
Provides the clean, mid-century geometric look.
Appropriate for the secondary yellow text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a middle-aged man with silver-grey pompadour hair, smiling slightly, wearing a multi-colored vertical striped shirt (muted tones). The background should be a solid, slightly textured deep blue with subtle vignetting. Leave the top 30% of the image as clear blue space for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main artist name in large, white, bold condensed sans-serif uppercase at the top left. Above it, add a short title in smaller yellow sans-serif uppercase. To the right of the name, add a block of small yellow text separated by bullets.

verificationChecks: Is the main text white and condensed?
Is the background a solid blue?
Is the hair styled in a 1960s pompadour?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the blue background
Check that the shirt stripes do not create a moiré effect
Verify the subject's expression is pleasant and professional
Confirm the top-heavy typographic layout is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Color Backdrop + Bold Condensed Sans-Serif Header + Secondary Color Sub-header = Classic Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
